function.description: List this address's Uniswap v3 liquidity positions: pool, range, whether it is in range right now, current holdings and uncollected fees. Defaults to your own wallet. Read-only. Uniswap v4 lands in a later phase.
function.name: defi_data_lp_positions

address.description: Owner address; defaults to the agent wallet.

chain.description: Chain to read Uniswap v3 positions on — the same address is a DIFFERENT token on a different chain, so name it deliberately. Readable: ethereum, base, robinhood, robinhood-testnet, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, solana.

protocol.description: Uniswap protocol: v3 (v4 in a later phase).
